text:
Jimmy Snuggerud has ten goals in 20 games in his second NHL season, which has made him a popular waiver pickup and one of St. Louis's few reliable scorers. Our wins-added ranks him 39th of 530 skaters.

The finishing is running hot, and our numbers say so plainly. Ten goals on 5.39 expected (the quality of his chances) is a 23% shooting rate, against 12% last season and a talent range that tops out around 16.5%. The Blues have also scored 4.04 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice. Both of those tend to come back to earth.

What is real is the role and where he plays. He is up to nearly 18 minutes a night, and the Blues take 52.2% of expected goals at 5v5 with him on, 3.7 points better than without him. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting to the home-plate area at a 96th percentile rate last season, with 29% of his setups coming from behind the net. Watch whether he keeps finding that ice once the puck stops going in at this pace.
headline: Jimmy Snuggerud's ten goals, and the part that won't last
